title: 第7章 全款买楼王！告别筒子楼-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》
content:
第(1/3)页

    售楼部大厅里铺着米白色的大理石地砖，亮得能照出人影。中央空调开得足足的，和外面那个快把人蒸熟的六月天简直是两个世界。

    “最大的户型多少平？”

    售楼小姐微微一愣，笑容没变，但眼神往林建国和林母身上快速扫了一圈。

    “我们最大的是256平，复式房型，楼王位置，南北通透，带独立书房和三个卫生间。不过那个户型……”

    她顿了一下，措辞很巧妙：“均价比普通户型要高一些，而且目前只剩两套了。”

    潜台词明明白白——贵，你确定看得起？

    林川一只手插在裤兜里。

    “好，带我去看实体样板间。”

    “好的，您稍等，我去拿一下钥匙——”

    售楼小姐转身往吧台走的时候，脚步不算快。那种礼貌里带着三分敷衍的节奏，接待了太多“只看不买”的人之后才会有的松弛感。

    林川没在意。

    他低头看沙盘的时候，余光扫到林小冉正踮着脚尖看最中间那栋标着“楼王”的模型，手指悬在半空，想摸又不敢摸。

    然后她的手突然缩了回去。

    “林小冉？”

    一个女生的声音从身后传过来，带着那种意外撞见熟人的上扬尾音。

    林小冉转过身，脸上的表情在一瞬间变了——先是认出来人的惊讶，然后是某种很微妙的、不太自在的收敛。

    “周……周婷。”

    来的是一个扎着半丸子头的女生，穿着一条看得出牌子的白色连衣裙，脚上一双小白鞋干干净净。她身后跟着一男一女，四十来岁，男的戴金丝眼镜，女的挎着一个棕色的皮包，一看就是那种日子过得不错的家庭。

    周婷的妈妈扫了一眼林小冉身上那件洗得发白的校服，又看了看旁边局促站着的林母，嘴角的弧度没变，但眼神里的东西比嘴角诚实得多。

    “哎呀，小冉啊，你们家也来看翡翠花园的房子啊？”

    那个“也”字咬得不重，但刚刚好能让人听出味道。

    周婷拉了拉她妈的手，小声说了句“妈——”。

    但她妈像是没感觉到，笑着接了一句：“这个小区确实好，就是价格在江城算顶尖了。我们老周在生意上忙了大半年，今天总算腾出空来，过来想把那个126平的三居定了。”

    说完她又看了林母一眼，语气里多了一层热心肠：“你们可以看看小户型嘛，89平那个也不错，两居够住了。我听说首付可以分期的，压力没那么大——”

    林母的手指不自觉地绞着衣角。

    林建国的脸绷着，喉结动了一下，嘴唇抿成了一条线。

    林小冉微微低下了头。

    这个动作很小，小到只有站在她旁边的林川能注意到。

    她没说话，没反驳，甚至没有表现出任何不高兴。

    只是低了一下头。

    但就是这一下，林川全看在眼里了。

    他不知道妹妹在这些年里到底吞过多少这样的“好心话”，咽过多少这样不咸不淡的委屈。

    林川抬起头，看了周婷妈妈一眼。

    “阿姨，126平啊。”

    他点了点头，语气随意得像在聊天气。

    “挺好的，够住了。”

    那个“够住了”三个字，跟周婷妈妈刚才说的“两居够住了”用的是一模一样的句式。

    周婷妈妈的笑容僵了一瞬。

    林川已经转过身，朝拿着钥匙走回来的售楼小姐招了一下手。

    “256的样板间，现在就带我去看。”

    售楼小姐眼皮跳了一下，点头在前面带路。

    周婷妈妈脸上的笑彻底挂不住了——256平？那不是楼王户型吗？

    样板间在一楼，单独辟出来的。

    门一推开，林母差点没站住。

Page (1/3)

The sales department hall is paved with off-white marble floor tiles, which are so bright that people’s silhouettes can be seen.The central air-conditioning is fully turned on, which is a completely different world from the steamy June weather outside.

"How many square meters is the largest apartment?"

The sales lady was slightly startled, her smile did not change, but her eyes quickly glanced at Lin Jianguo and Lin's mother.

“Our largest one is 256 square meters, a duplex type, the king of the building, transparent from north to south, with an independent study room and three bathrooms. But that unit type..."

She paused and worded her words very cleverly: "The average price is higher than that of ordinary apartments, and there are only two units left."

The subtext is clear - expensive, are you sure you can afford it?

Lin Chuan put one hand in his trouser pocket.

"Okay, take me to see the physical model room."

“Okay, wait a moment, I’ll get the key——”

When the sales lady turned around and walked towards the bar, her steps were not very fast.That kind of politeness with a perfunctory rhythm, a sense of relaxation that only comes after receiving too many people who "just don't want to buy."

Lin Chuan didn’t care.

When he looked down at the sand table, out of the corner of his eye, he spotted Lin Xiaoran standing on tiptoes to look at the model of the building marked "King of Buildings" in the middle. Her fingers were hanging in the air, wanting to touch it but not daring to touch it.

Then her hand suddenly retracted.

"Lin Xiaoran?"

A girl’s voice came from behind, with the rising tone of someone you accidentally bumped into an acquaintance.

Lin Xiaoran turned around, and the expression on his face changed in an instant - first he was surprised to recognize the person, and then there was some kind of subtle and uncomfortable restraint.

"Zhou...Zhou Ting."

What came was a girl with a bun, wearing a white dress with a recognizable brand, and a pair of clean white shoes on her feet.Behind her were a man and a woman, about forty years old. The man wore gold-rimmed glasses, and the woman carried a brown leather bag. At first glance, they looked like the kind of family that was living a good life.

Zhou Ting’s mother glanced at Lin Xiaoran’s white-washed school uniform, and then at Lin’s mother who was standing awkwardly next to her. The curvature of the corners of her mouth had not changed, but the expression in her eyes was much more honest than the corners of her mouth.

"Oh, Xiao Ran, your family also comes to see the house in Jade Garden?"

The word "ye" is not too strong, but it is just enough to make people hear the taste.

Zhou Ting pulled her mother's hand and whispered "Mom——".

But her mother didn’t seem to feel it, and added with a smile: “This community is really good, but the price is considered top-notch in Jiangcheng. Our old Zhou has been busy in business for more than half a year, and today he finally found time to come over and want to book a three-bedroom apartment with a square meter of 126 square meters.”

After saying that, she glanced at Mrs. Lin again, with an extra layer of warmth in her tone: "You can look at the small apartment. The 89-square-meter one is not bad. It is enough for two bedrooms. I heard that the down payment can be paid in installments, so the pressure is not that big——"

Mother Lin’s fingers twisted the corners of her clothes unconsciously.

Lin Jianguo’s face was tense, his Adam’s apple moved, and his lips pursed into a line.

Lin Xiaoran lowered his head slightly.

This movement was so small that only Lin Chuan standing next to her could notice it.

She didn’t speak, didn’t refute, or even showed any displeasure.

​​Just lowered his head.

But just now, Lin Chuan saw everything.

He didn’t know how many such “kind words” his sister had swallowed over the years, and how many such mild grievances she had swallowed.

Lin Chuan raised his head and glanced at Zhou Ting's mother.

"Auntie, it's 126 square meters."

He nodded, his tone casual as if he was talking about the weather.

“It’s pretty good, enough to live in.”

The words "enough to live in" are exactly the same as what Zhou Ting's mother said just now, "two bedrooms are enough to live in".

Zhou Ting’s mother’s smile froze for a moment.

Lin Chuan had already turned around and waved to the sales lady who came back with the keys.

“Take me to see the model room of 256 now.”

The sales lady’s eyelids twitched, she nodded and led the way.

Zhou Ting’s mother couldn’t hold back the smile on her face - 256 square meters?Isn’t that the King of Buildings type?

The model room is on the first floor and is set up separately.

As soon as the door opened, Mother Lin almost stopped standing.
